'''Pelleo Thog''' was a rich, successful [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] businessman who owned an estate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Torina]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he possessed a large collection of exotic animals. As Thog's wealth increased, he bought more and more animals, until [[Pelleo Thog's wife|his wife]] eventually complained about the size of his menagerie and he rehoused them inside a [[Pelleo Thog's zoo|zoo]], in the grounds of his estate. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Thog held a party on his estate, which was attended by some of his friends and business colleagues, as well as the Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] [[Alistar Dadefra]] and [[Tanda Pryl]]. Around the same time, Thog purchased a rare, albino [[Farlek]] from the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] pet shop owner [[Eeksa]].

==Personality and traits==
Thog was a bald, obese man, who was jovial and held a fascination for rare creatures. He was also a keen sportsman and he was skilled in the use of weapons such as sporting firearms and [[Bow/Legends|bow]] weapons.
